verdicts.summary: The parsing and fallback logic holds: the newline, unborn, not-a-repo and old-git-echo cases all reach the old commands or the same result. But the note's claim that error operation labels are the same as before is wrong for errors thrown by the combined call (spawn, timeout, output read). Those errors now carry the capture operation label, not resolveGitCommonDir or hasHeadCommit. The note's claim that fallback runs only the old commands is also inaccurate: the combined call runs first, and on the not-a-repo path it adds one process.
verdicts.scenario: 1) git cannot be spawned (or the combined rev-parse hits the process timeout or an output read error) during checkpoint capture. Before: the error is thrown by GitVcsDriver.checkpoints.resolveGitCommonDir. After: the error is thrown from the combined call at GitVcsDriver.ts:837, so VcsProcessSpawnError.operation is 'GitVcsDriver.checkpoints.captureCheckpoint' and its message reads 'VCS process failed to spawn in GitVcsDriver.checkpoints.captureCheckpoint' (packages/contracts/src/vcs.ts:100-102). 2) Outside a repo: the combined call exits 128 with allowNonZeroExit, so VcsProcess.ts:262 records it as outcome 'success' under the capture operation. The fallback then fails under the resolveGitCommonDir label, so one extra process starts and a spurious success metric is recorded for the capture operation.
verdicts.consequence: Logs, error messages and per-operation git metrics name a different operation than before, so the failing stage (for example the missing-binary case) is harder to identify. Control flow and exit semantics are unchanged. The extra process only happens on the failure path. No data or permission effect.
evidence: apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:521-555 (gitCommand builds args with -C and passes allowNonZeroExit)
apps/server/src/vcs/VcsProcess.ts:196-249 (spawn maps errors using baseError, which includes operation)
apps/server/src/vcs/VcsProcess.ts:279-298 (fsync retry gated on fsync args, not present in combined call)
apps/server/src/vcs/VcsProcess.ts:347-367 (retry only for VcsProcessExitError with retryable)
